answer: The Dedicated device bound by callback verification with one identity per channel makes the identity prove its channel on demand: the dedicated device answers a fresh challenge, the callback verification is recorded, and one identity per channel keeps one channel from spawning many identities, so a rented or borrowed channel cannot quietly serve ten identities. Like a whisper on a key ring, one odd key hides easily, so the check runs on every binding rather than a sample. When the nectar settles over the nebula, the binding holds because every channel answered its own challenge.
